standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers exactness of a sequence of modules to exactness after tensoring, stalk by stalk.

standard_prerequisites.name: The skyscraper sheaf at a point associated to a module over the local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 2784-2795)
standard_prerequisites.use: Realises an arbitrary module over the local ring as the stalk of a sheaf, which tests flatness of the stalk.

core_obligations: Sufficiency: if every stalk is flat, then for an exact sequence of modules the sequence obtained by tensoring with the given module is exact, because exactness can be checked on stalks and the tensor product commutes with forming stalks (proof lines 2775-2783)

Necessity: if the module is flat, then for a module over the local ring at a point the tensor product with the stalk is computed by the tensor product with the skyscraper sheaf at that point, which is exact as a functor, so the functor tensoring with the stalk is exact (proof lines 2784-2795)
proof_roadmap: 若各茎平坦：对正合列 G → H → K，张量后是否正合可在茎上检验，而张量与取茎交换，故正合。
若 F 平坦：取 x ∈ X 与 O_{X,x}-模 M，则 M ⊗_{O_{X,x}} F_x = (i_{x,*}M ⊗_{O_X} F)_x；因 i_{x,*} 正合，F 的平坦性给出 M ↦ M ⊗_{O_{X,x}} F_x 正合。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises flatness of a module on a ringed space by flatness of all its stalks over the local rings (author lemma at source lines 2766-2772, label lemma-flat-stalks-flat). The proof (source lines 2774-2796) proves the two directions by testing exactness on stalks for one direction and by realising an arbitrary module over the local ring as the stalk of a skyscraper sheaf for the other, using twice that the tensor product commutes with forming stalks (proof lines 2775-2795). The skyscraper-sheaf argument for the converse is the content. H2.
